HOW THIS TOOL IS MEANT TO BE READ. Getting any of these wrong is the failure this task measures:
- There are FIVE named results. They are reported side by side, each with its own gate. They are NEVER summed,
  averaged, counted ("3 of 5 passed") or turned into a score.
- There are THREE statuses: pass, fail and cannot-assess. A `cannot-assess` is NOT a pass. It means nothing
  was assessed there.
- `composite_score_from_the_scorer` is the scorer thread's own number, carried through for reference. It is
  NOT the verdict and no gate feeds it. Reporting it as the outcome is the error.
- `verdict.word_validated_withheld` and `verdict.withheld_because` are the actual verdict.
- `per_scale_coverage` says which biological scales could not be assessed at all.

Write `report` as prose for the collaborator: what was checked, what each of the five said, what the verdict is,
and what was not assessed. Fill `statuses` with the five statuses exactly as the output gives them, and
`withheld_because` with the reasons the output gives. Assert nothing the output does not contain.

model_output_parsed.report:
DELPHI's validate_generation compared the repository design "ff-zf-chimera" (generated) against "zebrafish-adult" (base). Your desired phenotype was parsed into 3 hard adult-stage criteria: glide_range_total_m >= 10 m from a 1 m launch (c1), and survival at 18 C (c2) and 28 C (c3). Nothing went unparsed or was refused. Two parser assumptions are worth knowing. Adult stage was assumed, and no editable parameters were stated, so an optimizer would have nothing to vary.

The five results, side by side:
- Genotype similarity: cannot-assess. The generated design carries no gene-level edit. The differences from the base are morphological parameter deltas, so there is no allele to score. No sequence was assessed: loci_covered = 0 and genome_fraction_assessed = 0.
- Phenotype similarity: pass. The body falls inside the calibrated shape distribution (p 0.2649). This is shape similarity to real specimens only. It is not relatedness, and it says nothing about features the comparison doesn't read.
- Lean check: cannot-assess. No Lean law could be evaluated (23 cannot-evaluate, 12 out of scope). No accepted-law violation was found, but that is not a pass.
- Functional resolution: cannot-assess. The ledger is empty, which is not evidence that there are no differences.
- Physics check: cannot-assess. The glide criterion (c1) has no model and was not checked, so the gate does not cover it. A standing check also failed and is reported beside the gate: only 84.7% of the requested flight-muscle volume fits inside the skin. The other 15.3% has nowhere to go, so any power claim that charges the full muscle mass is unphysical.

Verdict: the word "validated" is withheld. Four gates could not be assessed, three biological scales (cell, tissue, organ_system) could not be assessed, and no sequence was compared at any locus. Only phenotype similarity passed, and nothing failed outright. Your design has not been shown to glide 10 m.

The tool also carries a scorer composite of 0.8449. That is the scorer thread's own number, no gate feeds it, and it is not the verdict.
